name: FLA_PAYMENT_HEADERS_INT
description: FLA_PAYMENT_HEADERS_INT contains the payment headers information like payment type, payment purpose, frequency, vendor and asset etc.

columns.name: INTERFACE_PAYMENT_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Interface Payment header identifier. This column consistutes primary key along with LOAD_REQUEST_ID column of the table.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Oracle Enterprise Scheduler: request identifier of the interface load job that created the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: INTERFACE_LEASE_ID
columns.description: Interface Lease identifier from FLA_LEASES_INT table.

columns.name: INTERFACE_ASSET_ID
columns.description: Interface Lease asset identifier from the FLA_ASSETS_INT table. It is valid only if asset is associated to the payment term.

columns.name: ROU_ASSET_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether to generate right of use schedule for respective payment term or not.

columns.name: LIABILITY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if liability schedule for respective payment term should be generated or not.

columns.name: ARREARS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the payment is in arrear or not.

columns.name: CONVERSION_RATE
columns.description: Currency conversion rate used to derive the payment amount when the payment currency is different from functional currency.

columns.name: CONVERSION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Currency conversion type when the currency is different from the functional currency.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Payment currency code. This is entered by the user.

columns.name: PAYMENT_FREQUENCY_CODE
columns.description: Payment frequency code. Possible values are DAILY, MONTHLY, QUARTERLY, or ANNUALLY.

columns.name: PAYMENT_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of payment. Possible values are Cancelled and Active.

columns.name: OPTION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if this is a payment or an option.

columns.name: VENDOR_ID
columns.description: Supplier identifier. It is referenced from POZ_VENDORS table.

columns.name: VENDOR_NUMBER
columns.description: Unique number to identify a supplier.

columns.name: VENDOR_NAME
columns.description: Supplier name. Name of the supplier.

columns.name: VENDOR_SITE_ID
columns.description: Supplier site identifier. It is used to send the information to Payables during the payment process.

columns.name: VENDOR_SITE_CODE
columns.description: Physical location of the supplier.

columns.name: DISTRIBUTION_SET_ID
columns.description: Distribution set identifier. It is passed into Payables.

columns.name: DISTRIBUTION_SET_NAME
columns.description: Distribution set name as defined in payables.

columns.name: PAYMENT_TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Payment template identifier. References the template from which the payment term is copied.

columns.name: PAYMENT_TEMPLATE_NAME
columns.description: Payment template name. References the template from which the payment term is copied.

columns.name: PO_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Purchase order unique identifier. It references the PO_HEADER_ID column from the PO_HEADERS_ALL table.

columns.name: PO_NUMBER
columns.description: Document number used to request a seller supply a product or service for payment.

columns.name: REF_PURCHASE_ORDER_NUMBER
columns.description: Purchase order number for reference purpose.

columns.name: INTERCOMPANY_FLAG
columns.description: Intercompany flag with possible values as Y or N. Mainly used for reporting purposes, for future use.

columns.name: PAYMENT_PURPOSE_CODE
columns.description: Payment purpose. Values are populated from lookup FND_LOOKUPS where lookup_type = FLA_PAYMENT_PURPOSE.

columns.name: PAYMENT_START_DATE
columns.description: Date from which the payment starts. This will be validated against the first payment line start date.

columns.name: PAYMENT_END_DATE
columns.description: Date on which the payment ends. This will be validated against the last payment line end date.

columns.name: PAYMENT_TERM_ID
columns.description: Payment term identifier for calculation of due date.

columns.name: PAYMENT_TERM_NAME
columns.description: Name of payment term for an invoice.

columns.name: PARENT_INTERFACE_PAY_HDR_ID
columns.description: Payment header identifier for the parent Payment or option

columns.name: PAYMENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Payment type. Values are populated from lookup FND_LOOKUPS where lookup_type = FLA_PAYMENT_TYPE.

columns.name: PRIMARY_INTENDED_USE
columns.description: Tax Driver: The purpose for which a product may be used. The actual use is stored at the distribution level.

columns.name: TAX_CLASSIFICATION_CODE
columns.description: Tax classification code for payment term.

columns.name: TAX_INCLUDED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether tax is included or not.

columns.name: PRODUCT_CATEGORY
columns.description: Identifies the taxable nature of a noninventory based item for tax determination or tax reporting.

columns.name: PRODUCT_FISCAL_CLASSIFICATION
columns.description: Tax Driver: Product fiscal classification

columns.name: PRODUCT_TYPE
columns.description: Tax Driver: Type of product. Possible values are Goods and Services. This value defaults from Inventory Item attributes or is entered by the user.

columns.name: REPORT_FROM_INCEPTION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the schedules are generated from the inception of the lease or not.

columns.name: TRX_BUSINESS_CATEGORY
columns.description: Tax Driver: Transactions category assigned by user.

columns.name: USER_DEFINED_FISCAL_CLASS
columns.description: Tax Driver: Fiscal Classification.

columns.name: WITHHOLDING_TAX_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Withholding tax group identifier.

columns.name: WITHHOLDING_TAX_GROUP_NAME
columns.description: Used to apply multiple withholding taxes to an invoice line.

columns.name: OPTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Option type code. Possible values are Renewal, Residual and Purchase.

columns.name: OPTION_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Option status code. Possible values are Exercised, Closed, Expired and Terminated.

columns.name: PRIM_REGIME_ADDER_RATE
columns.description: Adder rate which is used for the primary regime.

columns.name: PRIM_REGIME_DISC_RATE_INDEX_ID
columns.description: Discount rate index that is used for the primary regime.

columns.name: PRIM_REGIME_DISC_RATE_IDX_NAME
columns.description: Discount rate index name that is used for the primary regime.

columns.name: SECD_REGIME_ADDER_RATE
columns.description: Adder rate which is used for the secondary regime.

columns.name: SECD_REGIME_DISC_RATE_INDEX_ID
columns.description: Discount rate index that is used for the secondary regime.

columns.name: SECD_REGIME_DISC_RATE_IDX_NAME
columns.description: Discount rate index name that is used for the secondary regime.

columns.name: SYSTEM_ORIGIN_REFERENCE_1
columns.description: System reference column to maintain the key of source system from which lease is being imported

columns.name: SYSTEM_ORIGIN_REFERENCE_2
columns.description: System reference column to maintain the key of source system from which lease is being imported

columns.name: FINANCE_ROU_BALANCE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Contains finance ROU balance for migrated leases.

columns.name: OPERATING_ROU_BALANCE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Contains operating ROU balance for migrated leases.

columns.name: FUNC_FIN_ROU_BALANCE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Contains finance ROU balance for migrated leases in functional currency.

columns.name: FUNC_OPER_ROU_BALANCE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Contains operating ROU balance for migrated leases in functional currency.

columns.name: MIGRATION_CONVERSION_RATE
columns.description: Migration Currency conversion rate used to derive the payment amount when the payment currency is different from functional currency.

columns.name: PO_LINE_ID
columns.description: Purchase order line identifier referenced from PO_LINES_ALL.

columns.name: PO_LINE_NUM
columns.description: Purchase order line number referenced from PO_LINES_ALL.

columns.name: INTERFACE_AGREEMENT_ID
columns.description: Interface payment increase agreement identifier.

columns.name: ACTUAL_AMOUNT
columns.description: Payment amount in the payment currency.

columns.name: NO_OF_PAYMENTS
columns.description: Number of payments to happen based on the effective dates and frequency.

columns.name: AMEND_ACTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Amend action type which identifies which action is being performed. Values could be INSERT and UPDATE.

columns.name: ASSET_NUMBER
columns.description: Asset number of asset to which the payment is associated.

columns.name: AGREEMENT_NUMBER
columns.description: Payment increase agreement number.

columns.name: PAYMENT_NUMBER
columns.description: Payment number of payment which is being updated.

columns.name: TRUNCATE_PAYMENT_LINES_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate if the payment lines needs to be truncated or not.

columns.name: PAYMENT_PREVIOUS_END_DATE
columns.description: Previous end date of the payment. Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: PAYMENT_SPLIT_START_DATE
columns.description: Start date of the payment line split. Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: ADJUSTED_CONTRACTION_AMOUNT
columns.description: Payment contraction line amount being sent by user through FBDI.

columns.name: REVENUE_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the method for spread of generated revenue, valid values are lease revenue and non lease revenue.

columns.name: SCHEDULE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the type of schedule, valid values are PAYMENT and BILLING.

columns.name: BILL_TO_CUSTOMER_ID
columns.description: Bill to customer identifier for the billing.

columns.name: BILL_CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_NUMBER
columns.description: Bill-to customer account number of the transaction.

columns.name: BILL_TO_SITE_USE_ID
columns.description: Bill to customer site use identifier.

columns.name: BILL_CUSTOMER_SITE_NUMBER
columns.description: Bill-to customer address site number. Site number represents a location in the system.

columns.name: SHIP_TO_SITE_USE_ID
columns.description: Ship to customer site use identifier.

columns.name: SHIP_CUSTOMER_SITE_NUMBER
columns.description: Ship-to customer account address site number. Site number represents a location in the system.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_TRX_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Transaction type identifier to be sent to Receivables.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_TRX_TYPE_NAME
columns.description: Transaction type name used to deriving the transaction type identified for Receivables.

columns.name: AR_PAYMENT_TERM_ID
columns.description: Payment term identifier sent to Receivables for calculation of due date.

columns.name: AR_PAYMENT_TERM_NAME
columns.description: Payment term name used to derive the payment term identifier of Receivables.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_SUB_TYPE
columns.description: Classification used by a tax authority to categorize a document associated with a transaction for a tax.

columns.name: FIRST_PTY_REG_ID
columns.description: Deploying company's Tax Registration number

columns.name: FIRST_PTY_REG_NUM
columns.description: First party tax registration number of the transaction.

columns.name: THIRD_PTY_REG_ID
columns.description: Bill-to Customer Tax Registration Number

columns.name: THIRD_PTY_REG_NUM
columns.description: Third party tax registration number of the transaction.

columns.name: AMORTIZE_EXEMPT_PAYMENT_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate if the exempt payment should be amortized over the term of the payment.

columns.name: GENERATE_INVOICE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate if the payment should be interfaced with Payables or Receivables during invoice creation.

columns.name: TAX_DETERMINANTS_SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Source of the tax determinants when the payment is invoiced. Values can be Setup and Payment.

columns.name: APPLY_UPFRONT_TAX_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether upfront tax is applicable or not.

columns.name: FIN_ROU_GROSS_BALANCE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Finance right of use gross balance amount for migrated leases.

columns.name: OPER_ROU_GROSS_BALANCE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Operating right of use gross balance amount for migrated leases.

columns.name: FINANCE_ACCUM_AMORT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Finance right of use accumulated amortization amount for migrated leases.

columns.name: OPERATING_ACCUM_AMORT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Operating right of use accumulated amortization amount for migrated leases.

columns.name: USE_FIRST_RECURRING_LINE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the payment or option line end dates are managed based on first recurring payment line.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
